{"text":"Hello {first_name},

This is {clinic_name}. We wrote to you before, and we want to say it again. We would love to see you for a follow-up visit. Please book by {due_by}. It is easy. Just call us at {clinic_phone}. We are glad to help.

Thank you for letting us care for you.

If you do not want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}"}
